reason: TASK.md Phase 2 forbids calibrating from the sample; calibration is estimated only in a full run. Stance (three-point vs stand-up) and Combine start type are not labelled in any provided file, and the global Combine-to-game offset needs Phase 3 in-game onset-to-cross times, which do not exist yet. No offset is estimated rather than inventing one.

estimator_spec.global_offset: precision-weighted mean of r_ij over all reps
estimator_spec.stance_offsets: one additive term per stance level, only if a stance label (or a Conor-approved inference rule) exists

required_inputs: a stance label or an approved stance-inference rule
downstream_contract: Full-mode consumers must call common.require_calibration_full; it refuses a placeholder or non-estimable record. Sample-mode consumers must not apply these numbers (there are none).
